profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at IBM
profile.summary: Experienced Senior Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the information technology and services industry. Skilled in Full-Stack Development, Application Architecture, Web Applications, Solution Architecture, and Agile Methodologies. Strong engineering professional with a Associate's degree focused in Management Information Systems, General from Community College of the Air Force.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: West Palm Beach, Florida, United States
positions.description: Lead developer and architect for the IBM Domino Applications on Cloud front-end.  The DAC front-end acts as the interface between the IBM digital marketplace and the DAC back-end.  When a customer places an order the front-end receives information about the instance ordered (how many servers, storage, etc.) and then which users to add to the instance.  The front-end stores data for the instance in the database, and send deployment instructions to the back-end. The back-end deploys the instance and periodically update the front-end with status of the instance.  The front-end also provides a web-based console that administrators can use to view status or manage their instance. Technologies used javascript, MongoDB, React, jenkins.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: West Palm Beach, Florida, United States
positions.description:
The IBM Apps program in the Collaboration Solutions division produces 
applications and assets outside of the normal IBM product set. The program is responsible for IBM's external Expertise strategy and our cloud customization efforts.  The apps business is an area of high innovation and a proving ground for new means of creating products. We specifically work on the MEAN (Mongo, Express, Angular, Node) stack and React pushing the limits of open source technologies and getting those advances and relevant capabilities into the hands of our customers. We ship a new app quarterly with excellent quality and reaction from the market.  Apps in the program include IBM Expertise 360°, IBM Expertise Locator, IBM Social Q&A, and Touchpoint as well as many others.   Skills used include:  Java, Javascript, Full Stack Development, MEAN, Angular.js, React, Mongo, Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, Redis, MongoDB, ElasticSearch, Watson APIs, Linux, Agile

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: West Palm Beach, Florida, United States
positions.description:
IBM Expertise 360° - IBM Expertise 360° consists of the IBM Expertise Locator and IBM Social Q&A as well as an API set that allows development of custom clients and data providers.  The common component is the Expertise Engine which mines your enterprise data to uncover expertise based on contributions to your collaboration platform and other corporate knowledge repositories.  This data can then be used in various clients to help users find experts in your organization.  Expertise 360 ships with data providers for IBM Connections, MS Sharepoint, IBM Social Q&A, others can be easily developed using the provided API.   
•	IBM Expertise Locator - Users can search for experts with the Expertise Locator client or can execute an expertise search using the Expertise html widget or chat bot integrated into a corporate application.  
•	IBM Social Q&A – Allows users to ask questions similar to Stack Overflow with the added ability to route the question to experts as determined by the Expertise Engine.  The system will also provide a list of similar questions to allow the user to use that answer rather than ask the question again.  Users can then select the most correct of the supplied answers.  Orgnizational users can then view all questions and answers and make comments.
•	Touchpoint – he IBM Connections Touchpoint provides an interactive user experience that can be used for a wide variety of end user touchpoint scenarios, such as new user profile creation, community and network contact recommendations, organization polling and more, driving user engagement and increasing the business value of your organization’s social business platform.
Skills used include:  Java, Javascript, Full Stack Development, MEAN, Angular.js, React, Mongo, Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, Redis, MongoDB, ElasticSearch, Watson APIs, Linux, Agile

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked on the IBM OBS (Outcome Based Solutions) project.  OBS integrates all your key applications into seamless workspaces.  OBS provides organization to take various and disparate 3rd party applications (Salesforce, JIRA, email, persistent chat, news, etc.) and place them on a single screen.  OBS will use AI and other techniques to allow viewing of this data filtered by a particular customer or task and allow that task to be followed until completion.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: West Palm Beach, Florida, United States
positions.description: Worked on the ISSC Social Learning Initiative (transformation project) within the IBM Software Services for Collaboration (ISSC) organization. We were working through the shift from a traditional structured learning environment (i.e. face to face classes) into a more consistent and easily accessed system of self-enablement that includes cultural change, business process change, as well as the entire content process from creation through multiple delivery channels.  The team developed Learning Circles, IBM Connections based communities that connect users needing skills with training material and experts in that skill.  The team also developed a set of web based tools that allow users and management to track progress and skillsets around the world.   Technologies used include Java, javascript, IBM WebSphere, IBM Connections, IBM DB2

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: West Palm Beach, Florida, United States
positions.description: Business Partner Technical Enablement.  Worked with several key IBM Business Partners to provide a higher visibility into IBM and to represent Partner interests to various teams within IBM. Focus area was the IBM Digital Experience line of products including IBM WebSphere Portal, IBM Web Experience Builder, and IBM Forms.  Worked with some of the IBM’s premiere partners to enable them to get key products delivered.  Provided assistance with architecture and design, training and helped develop proofs of concept.  Also during this time, I presented training sessions at key IBM events including Lotusphere, IBM Digital Experience Technical Conferences, and partner sponsored conferences.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Responsible for the design and development of IBM Forms for Mobile Devices.  IFMD is an XForms based system that allows partially connected mobile devices (PDAs, cell phones, etc.) to submit forms to a J2EE based server and then to backend systems.  Responsible for client and server.  Server is based on J2EE and DB2.  Client is based on MIDP and ESWE.  Responsibilities included write system and functional test plans, and leading the test effort.  Provided project management for all phases of the project. Provided demonstrations to executives, and technical experts.  Submitted four invention disclosures, two have been submitted to the patent office, two are currently in process.  Technologies used include:  MIDP/CLDC, SWT, eSWT, J2EE, J2ME, WebSphere Application Server, WebSphere Portal Server, DB2, and Web Services.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: West Palm Beach, Florida, United States
positions.description: WebSphere Everyplace Toolkit:  An Eclipse based toolkit that enables developers to create Portal applications accessed by on PDAs and cell phones.  Responsible for an Eclipse wizard that created offline portlets for mobile access to WebSphere applications.  These portlets were optimized for display on handheld devices.  Also responsible for the main driver that controlled 5 application wizards.  Technologies used: Eclipse, WebSphere Portal Server, WebSphere Application Server, and WAP.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: West Palm Beach, Florida, United States
positions.description: Solutions Development for Central Customer Master System (CCMS), part of the IBM CIO’s office.  Researched logging and auditing options for future additions to IBM’s CCMS.  Developed a J2EE-base MQ logging service for a proposed reorganization of CCMS.  Implemented a change to the Versata based CCMS system to update selected records.   Responsible for the design and development of the WBI Crossworlds portion of CCMS Service Bus. Designed and developed the Error Handler for OAF phase I.  Technologies used included Java, J2EE, IBM WebSphere, IBM MQ, IBM DB2

positions.title: Software Architect
positions.locationName: Miami-Fort Lauderdale Area
positions.description:
• Responsible for the design of an eCommerce site for a medical exchange client. The site allows a large number of medical practices currently using the clients practice management software to purchase supplies online from a large number of medical supply manufacturers. Technologies used are MS Commerce Server 2(X)(), LDAP, EDI, and MS SQL Server.

• Responsible for the design and development of an eCommerce site for FoodTrader.com. The site allows food buyers (wholesale) and sellers to enter into structured negotiations for lot quantities of food products. The site also allows for auctions (forward and reverse) and customized content for buyers and sellers. Technologies used were Java, JSP, JDSC, LDAP, MOAI, Vignette, and MS SQL Server.

• Responsible for the design and development of an eCommerce site for Marex,com. The site allows marine suppliers to sell to boat manufacturers through a common catalog. The site allows for catalog buying and auctions. Technologies used were Java, JSP, VB/COM, ASP, Oracle Financials, RightWorks, MOAI, and Yantra

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.locationName: West Palm Beach, Florida, United States
positions.description:
• Led a team of 11 SE's. Responsible for design and development of the eCharge Internet Payment Account application. IPA is an e¬commerce application that allows consumer's to make secure purchases on the internet without the passing of credit card numbers. Instead IPA allows the consumer to digitally sign for their purchases using the public key infrastructure (PKI). Lead developer on all aspects of the project including 00 analysis and design, construction and testing. Technologies used were Java, Netscape Application Server, PKI, and UML.

• Led a team of 6 SE's. Responsible for performing internet development utilizing tools such as CGI, Perl, C, ASP, JA VA and other industry specific technologies.

• Led a team of 17 SE's. Designed and developed the ITMS system. The Integrated Traffic Monitoring System (ITMS) is a comprehensive solution for multi-service carrier networks. ITMS instantly displays any network problems, providing immediate notification of network impacting events. Lead developer on all aspects of the project including 00 analysis and design, construction and testing. Technologies used were Rational Rose, MS Visual C++, MFC, and Windows NT.

• Designed and developed the Rule Parser subsystem for the EDS PRAS system for Continental Airlines. PRAS is a revenue accounting system. The Rule Parser deciphers the rule categories (date/time, length of stay, etc.) for all tickets sold and generates a memo for all rules that weren't followed. Lead developer on all aspects of the project including 00 analysis and design, construction and testing. This project was developed in C++.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: West Palm Beach, Florida Area
positions.description:
• Designed and developed the ComCentral fax printer driver for Windows NT, Windows 3.1, and Windows 95. The printer driver allows a user using any application to fax their document directly within their application by simply printing to the ComCentral printer from the print menu. Sole developer on all aspects of the project including analysis, design, construction, testing, and installation. Technologies used were MS Visual C++, C, Windows NT, Windows3.1, Windows 95, and AIX.

• Supervised a team of 4-7 SE's. Designed and developed the HC Markup! Application for AIX, OS/2, Windows NT, Windows 3.1 and Windows 95. HC Markup is a human centered (using speech recognition and visual enhancements to improve the human/computer interface) application that allows a user to send his document out for revisions/comments via computer. led developers on all aspects of the project including analysis, design, graphical programming, multimedia, and file i/o. Technologies used were C++, C , AIX, OS/2, Windows NT, Windows 3.1, and Windows 95.

• Designed and developed the Team Integration Environment (TJE). TIE is an object oriented API that allows users to develop applications across multiple platforms to access an MVS data repository. Duties included design and development; Systems Administration; some network administration (TCP/IP); consultation for UNIX skills; hardware maintenance; giving presentations to IBM customers; and visiting IBM customer sites.

positions.locationName: Plano, TX
positions.description: Assisted in the development, implementation, and maintenance of the EDSIINFORM system. This system allows the user to create and test ad hoc and preformatted reports on a PC and then run that request against a database on the mainframe. Languages used were FOCUS, C, and Intel 8086 assembler.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Hickam AFB, HI
positions.description: Provided programming support to tactical air force units throughout the pacific. Major systems developed included: Korean Combat Support System, home-grown TCP/IP system, Air Force Satellite Communication system, and an air-to-air combat simulation. Technologies and languages used were: C, Unix, Fortran, Pascal, Intel 8086 and Motorola 68000 assemblers. Upgraded the Korean Combat Support System from Cromix to UNIX V.2. Project included rewriting application programs written in 'C' and FORTRAN, rewriting the TCPIIP communications software, and writing UNIX device drivers to support the system unique communications hardware. Also responsible for providing small computer hardware support to units throughout the pacific.

patents.title: PRESENTING DATA TO ELECTRONIC MEETING PARTICIPANTS
patents.description: Described are a system and method for presenting web conference contents to one or more attendees in a shared session. Metadata is aggregated that is related to one or more participant electronic devices and a presenter electronic device that communicate with each other in the web conference. A presentation parameter is determined from the metadata. A selection interface is generated from the presentation parameter. A conference setting is selected from the selection interface. A set of content is presented at the presenter electronic device and shared with the one or more participant devices according to the selected conference setting.

patents.title: Enhanced handling of repeated information in a web form
patents.description: A presentation interface for rendering Web form content can include a Web form, a repeated item section, and a collection control section. The Web form can be written in a markup language based upon a Standard Generalized Mark-up Language (SGML). The Web form can include a repeating structure that references a collection of data items. The repeated item section can present the data items in a tabular format. The repeated item section can also include multiple selectors, one selector corresponding to each data item. The collection control section can include at least one user selectable collection actuator, such as a button, that performs a function associated with the actuator upon only those designated data items in the collection for which a corresponding selector has been chosen.
